definitions.explanation: A device used to measure a physical quantity such as length, temperature, voltage, or weight.

examples.japanese: {測定器|そくていき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{電圧|でんあつ}→電圧：19996_denatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{測|はか}る→測る：01977_hakaru⟧。
examples.english: Measure the voltage with a meter.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{測定器|そくていき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{精度|せいど}→精度：13787_seido⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: This measuring instrument is highly accurate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{様々|さまざま}→様々：01559_samazama⟧な{測定器|そくていき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{品質|ひんしつ}→品質：09507_hinshitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{管理|かんり}している→管理する：21910_kanrisuru⟧。
examples.english: At the factory, various measuring instruments are used to control quality.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{測定|そくてい}→測定：04398_sokutei⟧ (measurement) + {器|き} (instrument, device). A general cover term for measuring devices.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {測定器|そくていき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{測|はか}る→測る：01977_hakaru⟧: to measure with an instrument
- {測定器|そくていき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{精度|せいど}→精度：13787_seido⟧: accuracy of an instrument

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{計器|けいき}→計器：03946_keiki⟧: gauge, meter — often built into a machine, such as a dashboard
- ⟦{計測器|けいそくき}→計測器：26432_keisokuki⟧: measuring instrument — a near-synonym common in engineering
